RBI Proposes New Interest Rate Framework for Loans

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has proposed a new framework to rationalize interest rate structures for loans, aiming to enhance transparency and consumer protection. This initiative seeks to simplify how interest rates are determined and communicated to borrowers. Concurrently, the RBI has deferred new loan recovery norms until January, granting lenders additional time to comply. The central bank also extended a deadline related to certification timelines.
